svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Data and model lifecycle
svg.desc: Data and model lifecycle. 8 components in 2 groups. Connections: Weekly GitHub Actions job to LeetCode GraphQL (contest histories); update_data.py to Data PR (data/data.json); backtest.py to Data PR (docs/backtest.md); Data PR to train.py (after merge); train.py to export_model.py (model.keras); export_model.py to Model artifacts; Model artifacts to FastAPI on Render (committed if it wins).

text.tspan: A weekly job refreshes the data in a PR; retraining is manual and ships only if it wins the backtest
